nfl.oneThing: The 49ers are 6-0, but they will be without Mike Evans, Nick Bosa and Deebo Samuel Sr. for Sunday's game against the Falcons.

headlines.title: 49ers ruled out three key starters for Falcons game
headlines.summary: The 49ers ruled out receiver Mike Evans (Achilles tendinitis), defensive end Nick Bosa (calf) and receiver Deebo Samuel Sr. (hamstring) for Sunday against Atlanta. Evans and Bosa did not practise this week. Coach Kyle Shanahan said the team may enter the game with fewer than the maximum 48 players on the game-day roster, even after practice squad elevations. Ricky Pearsall is already out, so the receiver group is badly depleted. Shanahan said he had never experienced anything like it.
headlines.whyItMatters: The 49ers lead the NFC at 6-0 and have a bye week coming soon, which gives them some time to recover. The receiver depth will be tested in the meantime.

headlines.title: Giants lose Tremaine Edmunds, Cam Skattebo returns
headlines.summary: The Giants are without starting inside linebacker Tremaine Edmunds against the Texans. One report says he has a torn chest muscle that will reportedly end his season, while another says he is out for the rest of the season with a shoulder injury. Micah McFadden gets the start in his place. Andrew Thomas and Jermaine Eluemunor are both expected to play on the offensive line.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Giants are 3-2-1 and the NFC's No. 4 seed, so losing a starting linebacker for the season matters for the rest of their year.

headlines.title: Lamar Jackson still unsure about Bengals game
headlines.summary: Lamar Jackson is dealing with a high ankle sprain and is unsure whether he will play against the Bengals. He has missed the past two games. He said he is heading in the right direction. The Ravens are 4-2 and the No. 7 seed in the AFC.
headlines.whyItMatters: Baltimore is in the AFC playoff picture, and the quarterback situation will decide how competitive they are this week.

teamNews.title: Raiders prepare for Rams with injury questions
teamNews.text: The Raiders are 3-3 after losing three straight games since a 3-0 start. Mike Washington Jr. (foot) is questionable for Sunday against the Rams, and coach Klint Kubiak said defensive tackle Tonka Hemingway will return from a concussion for the game. Puka Nacua is questionable for the Rams with a calf injury.

recaps.keyLine: Maye 24/31, 321 yds, 2 TD, 1 INT · Stevenson 5 rec, 93 yds, 1 TD · Williams 22/33, 308 yds, 2 TD · Burden III 4 rec, 130 yds, 1 TD
recaps.text: The Bears beat the Patriots 30–24 in a one-score game, and they did it with Caleb Williams and Luther Burden III doing most of the damage. Williams threw for 308 yards and two touchdowns, and Burden caught four passes for 130 yards and a score. Drake Maye had a big game for New England with 321 yards and two touchdowns, but he also threw an interception. The win moves Chicago to 5-2, and it came at a cost, with tight end Cole Kmet suffering a serious right knee injury that will end his season.

contextCard.title: How NFL playoff tiebreakers work
contextCard.body: When two or more teams finish with the same record, the NFL uses a set of tiebreakers to decide seeding and playoff spots. The first tiebreaker is usually head-to-head results between the teams involved. Division and conference records come into play after that. This matters most in close races, when a team's place in the standings can depend on a single result.

nba.oneThing: The Sixers are 2-0 after coming back from a big first-half hole to beat the Cavaliers 114–106.

headlines.title: Sixers pass a big test against the Cavaliers
headlines.summary: Philadelphia beat Cleveland 114–106 after falling into a major first-half hole. Tyrese Maxey scored 32 points and dished six assists. Joel Embiid added 24 points and seven rebounds, and Jaylen Brown had 21 points and eight rebounds. LeBron James chipped in 17 points, 10 rebounds and five assists. Donovan Mitchell scored 32 points in the loss for Cleveland.
headlines.whyItMatters: The Sixers have started 2-0 and are the East's No. 1 seed so far, and they showed they can hold up in tough moments early in the season.

headlines.title: Knicks' phishing test draws criticism
headlines.summary: Madison Square Garden admitted that employees received a phishing email offering a championship ring as a cybersecurity test. The company called it an unfortunate mistake and said it was hacked in a similar way recently. Knicks coaches reportedly received empty ring boxes at the opening-night ceremony. MSG says it is giving more than 275 rings and jewellery to players, coaches and employees. Many longtime employees did not receive rings.
headlines.whyItMatters: The fallout is a distraction for a New York team that is 0-1 and sits at No. 8 in the East.

headlines.title: Knecht signs two-way deal with the Knicks
headlines.summary: Dalton Knecht has agreed to a two-way contract with New York. The Lakers waived him before the season started to create roster space. Knecht was the 17th overall pick in the 2024 draft out of Tennessee, and he had some success as a rookie with the Lakers. Knecht's agents told ESPN's Shams Charania about the deal.
headlines.whyItMatters: It gives New York depth, and it is a chance for a former first-round pick to find a role.

recaps.text: Philadelphia beat Cleveland 114–106 after the Cavaliers led early and took a big first-half lead. The Sixers shifted the game in the second half behind Tyrese Maxey and Joel Embiid, with Jaylen Brown and LeBron James adding production. Donovan Mitchell kept Cleveland in the game with 32 points and 10 rebounds, but it was not enough. The result leaves the Sixers 2-0 and the Cavaliers 0-1.

recaps.keyLine: Gordon 20 pts, 6 reb, 1 ast · Jokic 13 pts, 7 reb, 5 ast · Williams 21 pts, 5 reb, 3 ast · Gilgeous-Alexander 17 pts, 2 reb, 3 ast
recaps.text: Oklahoma City beat Denver 96–84 for its second straight win. Chet Holmgren was the standout, with 17 rebounds and four blocks to go with his 12 points. Jalen Williams added 21 points for the Thunder, and Shai Gilgeous-Alexander had 17. Nikola Jokic had 13 points, seven rebounds and five assists, and Aaron Gordon scored 20 for the Nuggets. Denver is 0-1.
